One column per value shown on the dashboard when the recording starts (phone and Android Auto pages), plus the GPS position when it is on. These values keep being read during the recording, even if you change page.

Time: time_ms from the start of the recording, and iso_time in local time with its offset from UTC, e.g. 2026-11-08T21:45:00.123+01:00 (+02:00 in summer in Paris), so a daylight saving change never mixes up the rows.
Latitude, longitude, altitude, speed, heading and accuracy, next to the ECU values. Android asks for the precise location when you switch it on.
Location refused. Allow \"Precise location\" for BimmerData in the app settings to record the position.
Waits for the connection to the car
Location is off on the phone
A position per second is enough for a map of the trip. Longer intervals save a little battery.
CSV recording: one column per value. Telegraf export: the points have the tag ecu=gps (ids latitude, longitude…); the example Grafana dashboard draws the trip on a map.
Cards: in the card editor, pick \"GPS\" in the list of ECUs (for example the GPS speed next to the speed read by the car).
With the cable, the position keeps coming with the screen off. In simulation, only while the app is open.
The position stays on the phone (CSV). It only leaves it to your own Telegraf server, if the export is on.

Stored compressed (gzip, about 10 times smaller) in the app\'s private storage. A point is deleted only once Telegraf confirmed it (HTTP 2xx).
